# ReviewPing
> Automated Google review request platform for local businesses. The $29/mo alternative to Podium.

## What ReviewPing Does
ReviewPing sends automated review requests to customers after their visit via Email, SMS, and WhatsApp. Customers tap one link to leave a Google review. Includes AI-powered reply suggestions for responding to reviews and a real-time analytics dashboard.

## Key Facts
- Pricing: $29/month Starter (free plan available — 25 requests/mo)
- Free trial: 14 days, no credit card required
- Channels: Email, SMS, WhatsApp (Pro plan+)
- Markets: India, United Kingdom, USA, Australia, Canada
- Primary use case: Local business review collection
- Key differentiator: 93% cheaper than Podium ($29 vs $399/mo)
- Founded: 2026
- Contact: hello@reviewping.pro

## Core Features
- Automated review requests via SMS, Email, WhatsApp
- Direct Google Review link generation (one-tap)
- AI Reply Generator for responding to reviews
- Smart Review Gateway (filter by rating)
- Real-time analytics and reputation tracking dashboard
- Competitor monitoring (track competitor reviews)
- Weekly email digest with review performance
- CSV contact import and management
- Multi-location support (up to 10 locations)

## Pricing Plans
| Plan | Price | Key Features |
|------|-------|-------------|
| Free | $0/mo | 25 review requests/mo, email only, basic dashboard |
| Starter | $29/mo | 100 requests/mo, SMS + email, AI replies, analytics |
| Pro | $79/mo | Unlimited requests, WhatsApp, automations, bulk send |
| Agency | $149/mo | Up to 10 locations, white-label, team members, dedicated support |

## Use Cases By Industry
- **Restaurants & cafes**: Send SMS review requests 30 min after dining
- **Dental & medical clinics**: Send email review requests after appointments
- **Salons, barbershops & spas**: Send SMS/WhatsApp after service
- **Home service providers**: Send SMS after job completion
- **Auto repair shops**: Send SMS after vehicle pickup
- **E-commerce stores**: Send email after delivery confirmation
